title: Effacement of positive two-term cohomology
statement: Let l be prime, s nonnegative, and A a finite ring killed by l^s. In the abelian discrete continuous A-linear representation category of the additive l-adic integers [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian], let T be any cohomological delta-functor whose degree-q functor equals H^q(K(-)), where K is the action complex for tau=1 [def-exc-action-two-term-complex]. For every q>0 and coefficient M there exist N and a monomorphism i:M -> N with T^q(i)=0.

source.place: Second paragraph, coinduced embedding; third paragraph, surjectivity and effacement

proof.text: Choose the natural orbit-map embedding i:M -> D(M) into the translation module of locally constant functions. Injectivity of i makes it monic, as cancellation can be checked on underlying linear maps.
The relation l^s*1_A=0 implies l^s*m=0 for every coefficient m. The locally constant primitive theorem shows rho_D(tau)-id surjective. Its cokernel, hence degree-one homology of K(D(M)), is zero.
For q>=2 the degree-q term is zero, so Mathlib HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero makes degree-q homology zero. Every positive-degree map induced by i has zero target and hence is zero.
